'''Ma Moomo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|Female]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] of the Moomo line.

==Biography==
When two of her children, [[Del Moomo]] and [[Dob Moomo]], got expelled from their herd, she told [[Dob Moomo|Dob]] to watch over [[Del Moomo|Del]] so he wouldn't hurt himself.
